dedupe_keys.name: survey data of the socio demographic economic and water source types that influences hhs drinking water supply

description: Shewayiref Geremew Gebremichael at Debre Tabor University publishes survey data on household drinking-water sources in northwestern Ethiopia. The Zenodo CSV and Word variable description are free under CC0. The study covers 418 urban households interviewed in February–March 2019 about water sources, demographic and economic conditions, sanitation and perceived water quality. These observations can inform household source-choice and service-access assumptions in drinking-water simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this survey. Coverage is a cross-sectional local sample, not a longitudinal utility record or a national demand estimate. Reported associations do not establish the causal effect of infrastructure investment, and seasonal coverage is limited. Coding, weighting, missing answers and representativeness require checking against the variable documentation. No household rows were downloaded, personal information inspected or regression results reproduced.
